@ a child that reads sample_tick() gives 0, 1, 2, … across the calls, and a call of 0 frames does not count
@ the time of the child is the time of the parent at every frame
@ a child that reads sample_tick() in its stage of sample / 4 reads the number of frames, not of ticks
@ the difference of the times of two ticks in a child is 4
@ the time in the argument of a delay of the child is the time of the parent before it
@ a grandchild reads the time of the program
@ a child that multiplies its input by the time
@ a child in an arm that is not chosen is run: when the arm is chosen the time is the time of the program, not the frames it was chosen
@ the replicas of a par~ read the same time, each with its own instance
@ a reset makes the next frame the frame 0 for the child, between the ticks too
@ a state of its own starts at 0 whatever the count of the other state
